description: In session.rs, read_command_line accumulates bytes until the buffer length exceeds max_bytes, returning LineTooLong only when buf.len() > max_bytes. This means a line of exactly max_bytes+1 bytes (including CRLF) is the longest accepted before rejection — off-by-one relative to the stated limit. The intent is to cap at max_bytes; the check should be >= not >. With MAX_LINE_BYTES=4096, lines of 4097 bytes are silently accepted.
title: smtp: read_command_line admits MAX_LINE_BYTES+1 bytes
